meta_title: SMC 24hr Building & Maintenance | Emergency Plumber Manchester
meta_description: SMC 24hr Building & Maintenance – emergency plumbing, repairs and maintenance across Manchester. Fast response, 24/7 availability. Call now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Manchester? Our emergency team arrives within the hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Building Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to planned maintenance and new installations, we handle it all around the clock.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Water pouring from a ceiling or pooling under your sink? We'll locate the problem and fix it fast, minimising water damage to your property.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Breakdowns
services.desc: No heating or hot water in the middle of winter? We diagnose boiler faults on site and carry parts to get you back up and running same day.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold radiators, leaks, or planning a new heating system? We install, balance, and repair radiators to keep your home warm and efficient.

services.title: Toilet & Bathroom Plumbing
services.desc: Running toilets, blocked drains, or shower repairs – we fix all bathroom plumbing issues and can advise on upgrades and new suites.

services.title: Kitchen Plumbing & Tap Fitting
services.desc: New kitchen installation or just replacing a tap? We handle pipework, drains, and all kitchen plumbing to code and on budget.

services.title: Planned Maintenance & Inspections
services.desc: Regular servicing and checks catch problems before they become emergencies, saving you money and stress in the long run.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone at 2 a.m. because emergencies don't wait for business hours.
about_para_1: SMC 24hr Building & Maintenance was founded to give Manchester residents a reliable emergency plumber they could trust any time of day. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for fast response times, honest pricing, and work that stands the test of time. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned boiler service, we treat every job with the same care.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we answer quickly, we show up when we say we will, and we fix things right the first time. We're not the cheapest, but we're fair – no hidden charges, no cowboy tactics. That's why Manchester families and businesses know SMC as the plumber to call when it really matters.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Pipe burst at 11 p.m. on a Sunday – called SMC and they were here by midnight. Fixed the leak, mopped up the water, and explained everything as they went. No fuss, no drama. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: My boiler packed in the day before Christmas Eve. I was panicking, but SMC's lad came out same day, diagnosed the problem and had heating back on by evening. Absolute lifesaver. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret K.

reviews.text: Used SMC for a full radiator and pipework job in our new kitchen. Professional, tidy, and they finished on time. No cutting corners. They've earned my recommendation and I'll be calling them back for our bathroom next year.
reviews.author: James P.
